config.mean_assumption: known_zero_mean; nondegenerate random initial state included in disturbance trajectory
config.plant_assumption: known dynamics; material-dependent synthetic coupled thermal deviation model
config.primary_endpoint: paired decision_shrinkage minus likelihood_shrinkage expected true noncausal-oracle regret, dr_regret controller, reported separately for every sample size and shift
negative_controls: different absolutely continuous nominal distributions with identical second moments produce identical controller objective
same adaptive interval updates with GP versus constant versus directly measured nominal gain
config.interpretation: No guaranteed estimator improvement. Radius is a design parameter, not an asserted finite-sample confidence set. Learned-dynamics uncertainty is not included in the known-dynamics theorem.

missing_pair_policy: Complete-case paired summaries are conditional on successful fits; failures and attempted budgets are retained separately.

same_moment_negative_control.law_construction: Nondegenerate Gaussian and Student(df=6), equal zero mean and population second moment
same_moment_negative_control.interpretation: Expected quadratic robust objective agrees; tail quantiles need not agree.
